special_mechanic: Short melee sequence supported by a shadow-clone feint
description_en: Strike the front enemy and gain Rage.
description_vi: Tấn công kẻ địch hàng trước và nhận Nộ.
canon_source: Naruto Part I combat identity
counterplay: Basic melee remains interruptible by hard control.
research_note: Part I baseline avoids later Wind Release techniques.

special_mechanic: Signature single-target burst with partial guard penetration
description_en: Naruto rushes in with a shadow-clone-assisted Rasengan for heavy chakra damage.
description_vi: Naruto lao tới cùng phân thân và tung Rasengan gây sát thương chakra lớn.
canon_source: Narutopedia Naruto Uzumaki - Rasengan acquired during Part I
counterplay: Can be interrupted during windup; mitigation and shields still apply.
research_note: Replaces invalid Part I Rasenshuriken candidate.

special_mechanic: Multi-hit physical pressure
description_en: Shadow clones surround the front enemy with a multi-hit rush.
description_vi: Ảnh phân thân bao vây kẻ địch hàng trước và liên kích.
canon_source: Naruto Part I Shadow Clone combat
counterplay: Armor and damage reduction mitigate each hit.
research_note: Core Part I clone identity.

name_vi: Loạt Phi Tiêu Đánh Lạc Hướng
special_mechanic: Creates ranged pressure without borrowing later techniques
description_en: Throw a clone-assisted kunai volley at a random enemy.
description_vi: Phối hợp phân thân ném loạt kunai vào một kẻ địch ngẫu nhiên.
canon_source: Part I standard ninja tools plus Shadow Clone design interpretation
counterplay: Dodge and physical defense reduce its value.
research_note: Conservative early-era third active slot.

special_mechanic: Once per battle low-HP Rage and resilience boost
description_en: Once per battle at low HP gain Rage and a short defensive boost.
description_vi: Một lần mỗi trận khi HP thấp nhận Nộ và tăng phòng thủ trong thời gian ngắn.
canon_source: Naruto Part I perseverance character theme
counterplay: Once-per-battle limit and dispellable defensive buff.
research_note: Gameplay passive inspired by persistent Part I characterization rather than a named jutsu.

special_mechanic: Natural-energy-enhanced melee
description_en: Strike with Sage-enhanced physical power and gain Rage.
description_vi: Tấn công bằng sức mạnh Tiên Nhân và nhận Nộ.
canon_source: Narutopedia Sage Mode Naruto
counterplay: Standard melee counterplay.
research_note: Sage stats flavor without consuming Frog Kata active identity.

special_mechanic: High burst with defense-shred style follow-up
description_en: Enter a focused Sage stance and hurl a Rasenshuriken at the weakest enemy for heavy damage.
description_vi: Vào thế Tiên Nhân tập trung rồi ném Rasenshuriken vào kẻ địch ít HP nhất gây sát thương lớn.
canon_source: Narutopedia Naruto Uzumaki and Sage Mode - thrown Rasenshuriken in Sage combat
counterplay: Interruptible windup; shields and damage reduction remain meaningful.
research_note: Signature Pain-arc Sage climax.

special_mechanic: Short-range invisible natural-energy reach with accuracy pressure
description_en: Use natural energy around the body to strike beyond normal melee reach.
description_vi: Dùng tự nhiên năng lượng bao quanh cơ thể để đánh vượt ngoài tầm cận chiến thông thường.
canon_source: Narutopedia Frog Kata; Naruto manga chapter 420
counterplay: Short cooldown but single target and lower burst than Rage Skill.
research_note: Exclusive Sage fighting-style identity.

special_mechanic: Medium burst and stagger pressure
description_en: Drive a Sage-enhanced Rasengan into the front enemy.
description_vi: Dùng Rasengan được cường hóa bởi Tiên Nhân đánh vào kẻ địch hàng trước.
canon_source: Narutopedia Naruto Uzumaki Sage Mode Rasengan usage
counterplay: Single-target and interruptible approach.
research_note: Rasengan remains important but below Rasenshuriken climax.

special_mechanic: Accuracy and control-resistance baseline from Sage perception
description_en: At battle start gain improved accuracy and resistance to control.
description_vi: Khi bắt đầu trận tăng chính xác và kháng hiệu ứng khống chế.
canon_source: Narutopedia Naruto Uzumaki Sage Mode sensing
counterplay: Passive bonuses are moderate and can be overcome by dedicated control builds.
research_note: Converts Sage sensory identity into readable combat utility.

special_mechanic: Six Paths chakra-infused basic pressure
description_en: Strike with Six Paths chakra and gain Rage.
description_vi: Tấn công bằng chakra Lục Đạo và nhận Nộ.
canon_source: Narutopedia Naruto Uzumaki Six Paths Sage Mode
counterplay: Standard basic-attack counterplay.
research_note: High-tier visual identity without making Basic a pseudo-Ultimate.

name_en: Sage Art: Super Tailed Beast Rasenshuriken
name_vi: Tiên Pháp: Siêu Vĩ Thú Rasenshuriken
special_mechanic: Nine tailed-beast chakra variations delivered as a cinematic multi-hit barrage
description_en: Create multiple tailed-beast chakra Rasenshuriken and bombard all enemies for massive multi-element damage.
description_vi: Tạo nhiều Rasenshuriken mang chakra Vĩ Thú và oanh kích toàn bộ kẻ địch bằng sát thương đa thuộc tính cực lớn.
canon_source: Narutopedia Sage Art Super Tailed Beast Rasenshuriken
counterplay: Long windup; damage is distributed across multiple hits and can be mitigated by shields/team defense.
research_note: Version-defining Six Paths climax.

special_mechanic: Area pressure with temporary defense reduction
description_en: Shape Truth-Seeking Orbs into a sweeping attack that pressures the enemy team.
description_vi: Biến Cầu Đạo Ngọc thành đòn quét gây áp lực lên toàn đội địch.
canon_source: Narutopedia Naruto Uzumaki Six Paths Senjutsu Truth-Seeking Balls
counterplay: Long cooldown and cleanseable defense debuff.
research_note: Exclusive War-arc Six Paths identity.

special_mechanic: Fast reach attack with execute pressure
description_en: Extend Kurama chakra to strike a weakened enemy from range.
description_vi: Kéo dài chakra Kurama để đánh kẻ địch đang suy yếu từ xa.
canon_source: Narutopedia Naruto Uzumaki Kurama chakra arms/HIGH_LEVEL_FORM
counterplay: Lower coefficient than Rage Skill and vulnerable to mitigation.
research_note: Fast utility damage distinct from the team-wide climax.

special_mechanic: Accuracy control resistance and limited ally support
description_en: Gain enhanced sensing and a modest team resistance bonus at battle start.
description_vi: Nhận cảm nhận tăng cường và tăng nhẹ kháng hiệu ứng cho đội khi bắt đầu trận.
canon_source: Narutopedia Naruto Uzumaki Six Paths sensing/Hagoromo power
counterplay: Team bonus intentionally modest and non-stacking with itself.
research_note: High-tier perception/support identity.

special_mechanic: Adult close-range chakra control
description_en: Strike with refined adult chakra control and gain Rage.
description_vi: Tấn công bằng khả năng điều khiển chakra thuần thục và nhận Nộ.
canon_source: Narutopedia Naruto Uzumaki adult combat
counterplay: Standard basic-attack counterplay.
research_note: Adult Naruto uses refined fundamentals rather than obsolete Truth-Seeking Ball basics.

special_mechanic: Large Kurama avatar artillery burst
description_en: Manifest Kurama's power and fire a Tailed Beast Bomb across the enemy formation.
description_vi: Giải phóng sức mạnh Kurama và bắn Vĩ Thú Ngọc vào đội hình địch.
canon_source: Narutopedia Naruto Uzumaki Tailed Beast Mode; adult retains Kurama partnership
counterplay: Long telegraph and team shields can absorb part of the burst.
research_note: Adult signature selected instead of reusing Six Paths Truth-Seeking Orbs.

special_mechanic: Fast adult Rasengan pressure
description_en: Form a Rasengan quickly and strike the front enemy.
description_vi: Nhanh chóng tạo Rasengan và đánh kẻ địch hàng trước.
canon_source: Narutopedia Naruto Uzumaki Rasengan mastery
counterplay: Single-target and moderate coefficient.
research_note: Adult mastery expressed through short cast/recovery.

name_vi: Đột Kích Ảnh Phân Thân Hokage
special_mechanic: Clone repositioning and multi-angle pressure
description_en: Use shadow clones to pressure an enemy from multiple angles.
description_vi: Dùng ảnh phân thân gây áp lực lên kẻ địch từ nhiều hướng.
canon_source: Narutopedia Naruto Uzumaki Shadow Clone mastery
counterplay: Dodge/physical defense and random targeting limit focus-fire reliability.
research_note: Classic identity retained without duplicating Six Paths kit.

special_mechanic: Once-per-battle Rage and team resilience response after ally KO
description_en: When an ally is defeated gain Rage and briefly strengthen team resilience once per battle.
description_vi: Khi đồng đội bị hạ nhận Nộ và tăng sức chống chịu cho đội trong thời gian ngắn một lần mỗi trận.
canon_source: Adult Hokage leadership characterization
counterplay: Once-per-battle trigger and temporary buff.
research_note: Leadership gameplay identity separated from Six Paths passive.
